title: Homebred

inlines.v: HO'MEBRED, adjective Native; natural; as homebred lusts. 1. Domestic; originating at home; not foreign; as homebred evil. 2. Plain, rude; artless; uncultivated; not polished by travel. Only to me two homebred youths belong.
